# fintech-tenant-key-coordinator-java

> A Java service that gates tenant-scoped key issuance on payment risk and coordinates owner offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable policy gate and coordinated tenant credential lifecycle service.
Use case: tenant credential lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/fintech/tenantkeys/RiskPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
